public_rationale: The original paper, published on December 14, 2023, describes the LLM generating function implementations within a supplied program structure [e1]. For cap sets, the designated component was the ‘priority’ function; separate system components executed, scored, stored and selected candidates for further search [e1]. This supports Marcus’s description of a prescribed role within a larger system: the reported result depended on that system, rather than the LLM solving the problem alone [e1].
limitations: ‘Very narrow’ has no quantitative threshold; the evidence establishes the assigned role, not how narrow it was on a numerical scale.
The division of work does not establish that the LLM’s contribution was trivial or that the results lacked novelty.
This assessment concerns the original FunSearch system, not later systems or its broader scientific importance.
